title: Feedback round
description: One round of a person's notes on a prototype, `feedback-round-<N>.json` beside the design. The prototype viewer's feedback mode writes it (Download, or Copy the JSON), the viewer lists the earlier rounds beside the design, and `aidd explore` pairs each item with the round's screenshots. `aidd validate` checks each file against this schema.

round.description: The round's number, the `<N>` in the file's name.

items.description: The notes, in the order they were given.

id.description: The note's id, `r<round>-<n>`, which a later round's `changes.json` names in `answers`.

kind.description: What the note asks for: change, remove, or add something, or a question. A file without it reads as change.

screen.description: The screen the note was given on, by its `data-screen` id.

state.description: The state the screen showed, by its `data-state` name.

testid.description: The `data-testid` of the element the note is about.

index.description: Which of the visible elements that share the test id, counting from 0, when several do, such as one card of a list.

box.description: Where the element showed in the frame's view when the note was given, in CSS pixels from the frame's top left.

note.description: What the person said, in their words.

frame.description: The device frame the note was given in, as the viewer's `frame=` key names it.

theme.description: The theme the note was given in: light, dark, or system.

link.description: The viewer's deep link to the view the note was given on.
